summary: Thomas Breen, 39, of Eagle, died when his paraglider crashed into a face on Red and White Mountain in the Ute Creek area above Wolcott; launched from a west face around 5 p.m., 911 call around 6 p.m., died at the scene; a dozen Vail Mountain Rescue members rallied to retrieve his body
location: Red and White Mountain, Ute Creek area above Wolcott
responding_agency: Vail Mountain Rescue Group; Eagle County Sheriff's Office
notes: Article published 2015-09-10 states died Wednesday evening; 2015-09-09 was a Wednesday. Source is the Vail Chamber repost of the Vail Daily feed (Randy Wyrick). Fills thin Eagle year 2015.
